purpose: Capability registry for literature discovery, completeness auditing, TOC retrieval, and website synchronization. The primary literature task must select the newest stable compatible capability on main before each fetch run.
fingerprintMethod: sha256 of newline-joined stable component labels and blob SHAs: literatureAudit, literatureWorkflow, journalRegistry, completenessGuard, tocCollector, publisherFallback

literatureAudit.validation: Production 2026-09-21 08:00 completion used the current three-calendar-day primary review plus seven-day multi-source machine safety tail: sourceRecords=528, primaryWindowRecords=45, machineSafetyTailAdditionalRecords=483, criticalSourceFailures=0, sourceFamilyGaps=0, and closureUnresolved=0. The implementation also widens from verifiedThrough after an interrupted closure and keeps Crossref online/published/created plus OpenAlex coverage.
literatureAudit.comparisonToPriorStable: The prior stable implementation used a seven-day window as the routine audit window. The current stable implementation makes three days the primary semantic-review window while retaining seven days of machine-only source coverage across Crossref online/published/created and OpenAlex. Already resolved days 4-7 do not become routine GPT re-review work; only genuinely unseen DOI differences surface. verifiedThrough catch-up automatically widens the primary publication range after interrupted/source-failure closure.
literatureAudit.semanticImpact: No source-recall downgrade is permitted: routine GPT review is three days, while seven-day multi-source safety-tail discovery, Crossref created/deposit rescue, 15-journal coverage, source-family health checks, all-difference review, prospective activation cutoffs, and persistent review decisions remain mandatory.

literatureWorkflow.validation: The workflow runs the completeness capability guard before the DOI-union audit, uploads the audit artifact, and retries persistence of audit/latest.json against concurrent main changes so an audit result is not silently lost.
literatureWorkflow.semanticImpact: Prevents silent regression of the 15-journal registry, prospective activation dates, seven-day rescan, Crossref created-date rescue, source-family health reporting, and all-difference review flow.

journalRegistry.validation: 15 canonical target journals are centralized. Chem, Chemical Science, CCS Chemistry, Science Advances, and Green Chemistry have activeFrom=2026-09-19; the original ten journals retain activeFrom=2026-07-01. Green Chemistry intentionally replaced Chinese Journal of Chemistry in commit 90e4cde8f7a1157caa5290ae407666801520d85b.
journalRegistry.semanticImpact: Prevents duplicated journal lists and prevents the new five journals from being backfilled before 2026-09-19 even when the safety window or late-deposit rescue reaches earlier dates.

completenessGuard.validation: The guard enforces 15 journals, three-day primary review, seven-day multi-source safety tail, verifiedThrough catch-up, Crossref online/published/created union, OpenAlex coverage, late-deposit observability, source-family health, no silent keyword exclusion, and now fails CI when component SHAs/fingerprint drift without either a synchronized stable registry or an explicit pendingValidation fingerprint.
completenessGuard.semanticImpact: CI rejects source-recall regression and silent capability-version drift. A changed fetch component can no longer be merged as an untracked capability state.

websiteMediaSync.validation: GitHub Pages run 35418810801 succeeded with galleryDois=463, workerItems=463, finalRecords=407, failures=0 and figure metadata=716
websiteMediaSync.semanticImpact: Downstream media synchronization coverage only. Adds rolling-supplement.json to media sync; does not alter literature discovery, inclusion decisions, or upstream TOC retrieval.

recentMediaRepair.validation: GitHub Actions run 35419525431 completed successfully on the Sep 18-19 reviewed literature update; it prepared 30 recent gaps, attempted direct publisher retrieval, ran the Worker fallback, verified inventory, and triggered Pages refresh.
recentMediaRepair.effectiveness: Publisher direct retrieval remained blocked by ACS/Wiley 403 and Nature IDP for most targets; the workflow is operationally stable but currently low-yield without an authenticated browser/VPN source.
recentMediaRepair.semanticImpact: TOC/media repair only. Does not change literature discovery or inclusion decisions.
